speaker: Sister Tamara W. Runia
title: The Sculpting of Our Souls
session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Sister Tamara W. Runia spoke about “The Sculpting of Our Souls”.

quotes.text: Thirteen years ago our oldest son, Ryan, woke up on a Monday morning, kissed his wife and four young children goodbye, and left for work. A few hours later, he collapsed and died from undetected hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. His heart simply stopped.
quotes.speaker: Sister Tamara W. Runia
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I’ve often wondered if the Prophet had any idea when he received this revelation what these words would mean to so many of us now who are also turning to God, pleading for a break.
quotes.speaker: Sister Tamara W. Runia
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: God’s answer implies that experience is valuable, and I’m learning the only way to get it is to go through it. Can’t we skip over it? Is there some other way? No, there isn’t another way.
quotes.speaker: Sister Tamara W. Runia
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: It’s like we heard these lessons in a premortal classroom. We studied it there, and we’re living it here, in this laboratory of life. This is where we “put on Christ.”
quotes.speaker: Sister Tamara W. Runia
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: C. S. Lewis explained, “God intends to give us what we need, not what we now think we want.” But sometimes we’re puzzled when we get what we need, aren’t we? How can our loving Father in Heaven watch as we go through heartbreaking experiences? I’ve wrestled with this, and maybe you have too.
quotes.speaker: Sister Tamara W. Runia
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: When an angel asked Nephi, “Knowest thou the condescension of God?” he humbly answered, “I know that he loveth his children; nevertheless, I do not know the meaning of all things.”
quotes.speaker: Sister Tamara W. Runia
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: It is precisely because He loves us that we’re having these tempering, refining experiences. God knows, and we are here to learn, that we must become like Him so we can live with Him!
quotes.speaker: Sister Tamara W. Runia
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I testify that during those sanctifying experiences, when growth is taking place and God is at work, our stories may not look like success to others. In fact, on the outside it may look like things are sort of unraveling or falling apart, and it will certainly feel that way.
quotes.speaker: Sister Tamara W. Runia
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference
